world: The Glow — the light coming back on inside her. Dark indigo 'before' world; gold glow = the after-state; the deep-magenta flame gummy is the Ember.

tokens.type_stack: Bricolage Grotesque (display) / Newsreader (body) / Hanken Grotesk (eyebrow, 2px tracking)
rules: dark pouch + small lights = shelf differentiation

wordmark.twin_wick: the two 'i' dots are lit wicks with small gold flame glows

compliance.claims_rule: 'supports' framing only — no disease/medical claims. Personal-experience framing ('I felt...') is fine.
compliance.names_locked: brand is always 'liitt'; product is always 'Fairy Flame'; call the active 'microdose gummies' only — never name specific actives in ad copy
compliance.glow_rule: 'glow' means inner light returning, never skin/beauty glow

avatar: The Vanished Woman — high-functioning woman 40-55 who did everything right and still doesn't feel like herself. After-language: 'I feel like myself again.'
style_suffix: editorial mystic photography, deep indigo night palette with warm gold glow accents, premium calm aesthetic, cinematic soft light, photorealistic, high-end wellness brand, muted and restrained
negative_prompt: candy colors, neon rave, psychedelic trippy patterns, clutter, cheap stock photo look, oversaturated, discount promo style, text, watermark, low quality, blurry, deformed hands, extra fingers

presets.label: Product hero — dark pouch, the Glow
presets.prompt: matte dark-indigo product pouch on a dark stone surface, two small warm golden lights glowing beside it, single beam of soft gold light from above, deep magenta flame-shaped gummies spilling artfully, editorial product photography

presets.label: Pain mirror — the before state (b-roll)
presets.prompt: woman in her 40s at a kitchen table at dusk, blue-grey fog-like light, palm to forehead, mail piled up, wine glass untouched, exhausted but holding it together, documentary realism, muted cold palette

presets.label: Glow moment — the after state (b-roll)
presets.prompt: woman in her 40s laughing warmly in a golden-lit kitchen in the evening, singing to herself while cooking, family blurred in warm background, light literally warmer around her, candid joyful realism

presets.label: Ritual macro — the Ember
presets.prompt: extreme macro of a deep magenta flame-shaped gummy held between two fingers against a dark indigo background, single warm gold rim light, glowing as if lit from within, luxurious minimal composition

presets.label: Identity hook — the old photo
presets.prompt: hands holding a printed photograph of a vibrant smiling woman from ten years ago, dim evening bedroom light in the present, emotional cinematic contrast between the bright photo and the muted room

presets.label: liitt coffee — morning ritual
presets.prompt: mushroom coffee in a ceramic mug on a dark wood counter at dawn, steam catching a single ray of warm gold morning light, dark indigo shadows, calm premium morning ritual, editorial still life

usage_note: Presets map to the angle bank: pain-mirror/glow-moment serve an-0001 (red flags -> root cause) before/after beats; old-photo serves the identity-reclamation hook class; product-hero/ritual-macro are offer-stack statics. All output must respect 'supports' framing — never render medical claims as text.
